nom: Avène Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream

avis.titre: It keeps my skin radiant and soft

Been using this cream for a few weeks. It's a thick cream that I wish melted more into my skin. That said, when I have used it consistently over a few days, I notice that my skin looks smoother - no glow - just even toned.
It's lightweight and my skin was hydrated for most part of the day ,
Good.. Thank you for this amazing sample.. Definitely recommend to my friends and family

I received this product in a mini sample for free in exchange for my review. The texture feels gentle on the skin and east to apply. My skin felt hydrated right away. It gives radiant skin look in the end.

I only wish it was a larger sample. I only had enough to try once, but that one time left my skin hydrated and soft. I would recommend.
I like this cream a lot. My skin already got better after trying it for 2 weeks.
This cream feels very luxurious and rich. My dry skin loved the moisture and I looked 10 years younger from the glow.

avis.titre: it's a solid choice for those looking to boost radiance and
avis.texte: The cream has a rich, velvety texture that absorbs well, leaving the skin soft and moisturized without a greasy residue. Many users appreciate its gentle formulation that suits sensitive skin and works well as a makeup base. Additionally, its refillable glass jar makes it an eco-conscious choice.
I love how it made my skin so soft n glow.im really thinking about getting this cause it made me really happy.
My skin felt so smooth and soft. Has a healthy glow and feel. Helped to balance out the dry and oily parts of my face.
I love how well this goes on. It's not really thick like some brands. It made my skin feel amazing!
I was very surprised at this product. It is very thick and absorbant! I LOVE! The best vitamin C product that I've used.
This was a very nice cream on my skin. It definitely brightened my skin.

Avene Vitamin Activ CG Radiance Intensive Cream is a lightweight yet hydrating moisturizer that leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed. It absorbs quickly without greasiness, and the stabilized vitamin C helps brighten my complexion over time. While it provides a nice glow, the results are subtle, so it's best for those looking for gentle radiance rather than dramatic brightening.
I received this Vitamin Active Cg Radiance Intensive Cream from POPSUGAR Dabble for free for my honest review. I really liked how it made my skin feel nice and moisturized and fresh.
I got it free and explored with this intensive cream in my face daily. Unfortunately, it was a sample and ran out of it. I won't know what result would be for 30 days. Dang it.

I recently had an opportunity to try the Avene Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream and admittedly, I wasn't all that impressed. While it absorbed into my skin and layered with my other products fairly well, there was nothing special about this product. I will stick with the vitamin c that I currently use.

I loved trying this sample of face cream. It was so light and absorbed nicely without feeling heavy. My skin felt quenched and looked plumper and happier. I'm excited to see the long term benefits when my full size product arrives. I highly recommend this, especially for a bit more mature facial skin.
I absolutely loved this product. It made my skin so soft and gooey. I recommend this if you have dry skin.
I thought it was a nice smooth cream for my face but curious how much a full product costs.
My skin soaked it right in and it had a little glow to it afterwards. I liked it.

Love this product have been using it every morning for the last 6 months along with the gentle cleanser and thermal water spray. I top it off with the tinted sun screen. My skin is clear, smooth and radiant!
Wasn't the best product I have ever tried, but for the price, it is a great vaule
This felt really nice in my skin. No burning and wasn't too heavy. It felt really quality and didn't smell bad.
Love the wonderful beneficial ingredients but would prefer no fragrance. After a few uses it has made my skin brighter and smoother! Will continue to use to see more benefits.

I just added this to my skincare routine - I didn't use it in place or anything. This product left my skin feeling soft and glowy. It didn't look greasy or feel sticky. I have sensitive combination skin and this went on smooth and left me with a glass skin look. I 10/10 would recommend this product. I'm a big texture and smell person so I easily throw out products and tend to be pretty picky.
Nice light cream that goes on smoothly. Moderately hydrating and comfortable on skin.
Vitamin activ Cg radiance intensive cream was highly enjoyable!

Rich and indulgent skincare that is a must during cold skin drying winter season. Works great under makeup as a rich primer.

Improvement in skin tone and radiance. I would like to recommend this to my friends.
This cream goes on smooth and absorbs instantly. It leaves skin intensely hydrated, plumped and adds a visible glow, I think it's perfect for those with dry skin! The smell is very pleasant as well.
Like the way it makes my skin feel. Will definitely keep using
The product goes on smooth and makes my skin feel great. I believe with longer use and consistent use it could really improve my skin's radiance and glow
I found this to be a little greasy. Just did not absorb as well as I expected it to. But other than that, nice cream.

I'm always looking for products that improve my skins condition without triggering my many allergies and sensitivities, and this is one of those items you finally find and is worth it's weight in gold.
Loved it. It made my skin silky soft and it felt like it was glowing.
A little tacky but overall moisturizing. Smell not too strong.
I love this cream! It's smooth and not greasy. I bought a full size shortly after using my sample.
Very hydrating and definitely see the brightening effect while it's on. I have noticed any long term effects yet.
It's really hard to review a product with such a small sample. All I can is that it smells nice and glides onto my skin. It didn't leave a tacky residue.

I love the way this cream makes my skin look. My skin was glowing!!

Since all I have tried is a sample of this its hard to identify if the benefits really work as claimed, however like all there products it felt nice on the skin and in the few days that I did used it my skin felt moisturized and overall nice. Look forward to purchasing a full size to get the full affects.
Glides on smooth and feels nice. It was hard to see a significant difference in just a sample size but it seems like a good product that would give you good results in the long run.
I'm so glad I got this sample. It's everything you want in a moisturizer. It's very creamy and sinks into the skin quickly.
No averse reaction to the sample, but will take full size and more time to see results, if any.

I like how it easily absorbs into my skin and makes my skin soft to touch although a little sample size would not really be enough to see any results/ changes to my skin to provide any other feedback or to recommend it to other people.
I gave the sample to my wife to try. She said she didn't like it because it was greasy.
This product was great. I was not able to see any results because h the sample was so small.

This product applies smoothly and leaves my skin feeling fantastic. With consistent, long-term use, I believe it has the potential to enhance my skin's radiance and even out my tone for a healthier glow.

For winter skin, this cream was perfect. I applied it after washing my face and before applying makeup. It was not greasy, absorbed well into my skin, and had a pleasant scent. I'm unsure if it would be too creamy for the summer, but it works well with my drier winter skin. I was sad to have used the entire sample so quickly. I did look into purchasing it and found the price to be a bit on the high side, though not unlike some other similar moisurizers.

I tried Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream and liked the light yet smooth feel. I tried it for a week and noticed a slight change in my skin. I will continue using it and will follow with the results.

I tried this product consistently for several days and I could really tell the difference with my skin texture. I felt my skin feel smoother and look a lot brighter. I love that this product does not leave a greasy film like other creams I've used in the past and I will definitely add this to my skin care routine.
Great product that is of high quality. Can't wait to see more!

This stuff is amazing it feels good on your face it light weight not sticky its just right. I dont know if it done anything to change my face because it's just a sample and I think it said it takes a few week to see the results but I'm going to buy some to see if it does
Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream leaves your skin soft and smooth. It has great texture.
I like this cream just tried it for a week and already seeing a difference. M'y skin feels soft,, bright and smooth. I have a sensitive skin it doesn't damage or irritates it. I will recommend it

avis.titre: Good product. May not use often.
avis.texte: I liked the product overall, but I didn't see much change in my skin tone/quality. Granted it was a small sample.
After trying the sample, I like it a lot! it does show some sign of improvement on my skin. I plan to try a real product soon and hope it will improve my skin condition.

The Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream is the perfect weight for a cream. It absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling dewy and glowing at the same time. The fragrance is very subtle and very nice.

I received a free sample of the Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream. I definitely liked the main ingredients in this cream because I have found those ingredients to be effective. The cream texture is good. It's on the rich thick side and feels nice on the skin. My entire issue with this product is the scent. It's just too strong and kind of cloying. I tend to stay clear of face care products with strong fragrance so this was not for me. That said, if you don't mind that sort of thing the cream is good.
I love how my skin feels after using this serum. I can feel a difference after using for a week.

avis.titre: You can really see the glow
avis.texte: This made my skin shine like it never has before. I loved it!
Good moisturizing ability. Penetrates into the skin quickly, improves the skin condition markedly, the scent is gentle. Packaging products, handy

I was so very thankful to get to try this new Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream... It's a Yes! Definitely!! I loved it, boom thank y'all so much!

Avene makes high quality skin care! This vitamin c intensive cream leaves you radiant and moisturized with great benefits.
This cream helps revive my skin when it's struggling a bit. It also smells really good.
Love the smell of the cream and feels great on your skin. The cream is the perfect thickness.

I loved using this product on my face it's nice and hydrating afterward. It is very easy to apply as well which i love.
Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream rehydrated my dry skin.
The Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream leaves the skin feeling moisturized and nourished. It's easy to apply and doesn't leave a residue feeling behind.
Its too sticky for me. I do not feel the soft skin after used like other vitamin C i had used.

avis.titre: Vitamin Activ cg Radiance Intensive Cream
avis.texte: I enjoyed the thickness of this cream. It's presence was welcomed and soothing applying it to my freshly cleansed facial skin. When I looked in the mirror, I saw a calm and smooth skin. I would highly recommend this cream.
This product made my skin glow all morning and have a plump look. It made me feel radiant and feel fully moisturized and hydrated.
This brand is one of my favorites! It is so reliable and always does what it says. My skin loves Avene and every products I've tried feo them.

I didn't get enough product to make much of a review but from the two applications-it didn't break me out or cause redness which I appreciate. No offensive odor. It gave me enough moisture for a day cream but not enough for a night cream. Overall I would need more of the product to decide if it is for me or not.
